content: yt-dlp supports --download-sections "*START-END" to extract only a time range server-side (avoids downloading full video), combinable with -x --audio-format for audio-only extraction. For frame-accurate trimming, pairing with ffmpeg -ss/-to (note: -to is exclusive end) is the standard pattern; -ss before -i is fast (keyframe seek) but less accurate, -ss after -i is accurate but slower (re-encode).
